_doc: Known-ambient snapshot differences between two separately launched games, used by two_game_test.py.
Each entry names ONE quest script variable (exact EDID + exact var name; no wildcards) whose value is driven by real-time timers or
per-launch randomness, so two games can never agree on it. Entries may NEVER cover quest stages, objectives, running flags, globals,
faction ranks or any non-variable path: the loader rejects them. Every entry needs a reason and a coordinator approval.
Anything not listed here counts as a real difference and fails the run.

entries.reason: real-time clock accumulator (seconds since launch), differs per process by construction
real-time clock accumulator (days since launch), differs per process by construction
rain animation phase, advanced every frame from the wall clock
rain animation depth, advanced every frame from the wall clock
